title: What happens after you hit Enter

scenes.caption: Your AI never reads a single *word*.
scenes.say: What actually happens after you hit *enter*?

scenes.caption: You ask. It answers *instantly*.
scenes.say: You ask a question. The answer shows up *instantly*.

scenes.caption: First your text gets *chopped* into tokens.
scenes.say: First, your text gets *chopped* into tokens.

scenes.caption: Tokens become *numbers* the model can use.
scenes.say: Every token becomes a *number* the model can work with.

scenes.caption: Attention links the words that *matter*.
scenes.say: Then attention works out which words *matter* to each other.

scenes.caption: Then it bets on the *next token*.
scenes.say: And the model places a bet on the *next token*.

scenes.code:
while not done:
    probs = model(tokens)
    nxt = sample(probs)
    tokens.append(nxt)
scenes.caption: One token. Add it. *Repeat*.
scenes.say: It picks one. Adds it. And *repeats*.
